status: Retrospective descriptive check proposed after v1-v6 aggregate results; not a new prediction experiment.
input: All original per-probe before/after32 reference losses, separately for256actual training and64actual development cases. All16+8 zero controls retained.
method: Recompute unchanged4-probe target. Score each of4probes with the same32-category argmax and.02 no-change floor. For every case compare all3unordered complementary2-probe partitions:01vs23,02vs13,03vs12. Report agreement, all4singleton agreement, singleton-to-original-gold agreement and complete per-case records. Report source-label versus measured-label agreement only descriptively.
no_inference: No confidence claim from treating repeated probes or overlapping partitions as independent. This is not a Bayes error bound or a proof that prediction is impossible.
decision_rule: Use evidence to assess whether future decoder input needs prompt context. Do not change original targets or70percent gate, drop unstable cases, relabel source tasks as effects, release tests or promote a partial endpoint.
